reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: K-loss plus matched WT/kinase-dead rescue, with conditionally validated orthogonal catalytic perturbation.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult detailed prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols before execution and verify condition transfer. Generic established procedures or partner-literature lookup are insufficient.
No matched non-targeting editing control for the CRISPR route; using an independent degron null reduces adaptation concerns but does not replace the procedural editing/selection comparison.

The pooled knockout is presented as established necessity, and successful noncatalytic rescue is equated with scaffolding specifically. Neither claim is justified solely by the supplied packet and phenotype rescue.
Genetic insertion, degron and AS preparation details, quantities/exposure times and culture conditioning remain unspecified without an executable calibration-to-choice procedure.
Specificity controls are strong, but analytical linearity/background/recovery and an objective quantitative accuracy acceptance gate are not supplied for the ratio measurements.
No background, below-limit, saturated or missing phospho/total-S ratio rule, nor quantitative growth-denominator/death-versus-division handling.

checks.quote: size replicates from the KO effect magnitude in M1
checks.reason: M1 supplies no numerical magnitude or variance. No independent pilot obtains those quantities for the WT-KD and equivalence contrasts; fixed clones/days and desired power alone cannot size the study.
Mixed models and TOST are specified, but no multiplicity family/correction or gatekeeping across the two endpoints and multiple genetic/chemical contrasts.
Re-engineering and troubleshooting lack a refrozen design and fresh independent confirmatory cohort.

No quantified activity detection bound tied to the minimal activity sufficient for rescue. Labeling the assay result dead does not exclude functionally consequential residual catalysis in the dispensability decision.

Physical protein presence and in-vitro analog inhibition do not establish maintained scaffold behavior or adequate functional inhibition in intact cells. The limits acknowledge conformation-dependent scaffold loss but the orthogonal arm does not test it; see primary example https://www.nature.com/articles/nature08833.
No sample-to-raw-file linkage and exact analysis-code/environment/settings versions.

Authenticated cells, phosphatase/peptide specificity controls, fold/localization/partner comparisons, multiple nulls and correctly nested clones are useful. Randomized plates, coded analysis, technical stopping, TOST and a bounded half-log ligand pilot with EC-defined choices are concrete. Causal and assay-tool limitations are discussed, but the required activity/scaffold separation is not operationally verified in the key decisions and chemical arm. P13/P14 own these defects without duplicate general inference penalties.
